summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted for initiation of intravenous Remodulin therapy due to persistent hepatopulmonary syndrome despite prior treatment with sildenafil and inhaled treprostinil. A tunneled central venous catheter was successfully placed on 2177-09-01, and Remodulin was initiated at a low dose, gradually uptitrated to 5 ng/kg/min over 48 hours. He tolerated the therapy well with only mild fatigue, remained hemodynamically stable, and showed stable laboratory values. His home medications were continued, including management for cirrhosis, chronic pain from vertebral osteomyelitis, depression, and GERD. He was discharged home with a continuous Remodulin infusion, detailed education on pump and line care, and plans for outpatient dose adjustment to improve eligibility for liver transplantation.
problems: Unspecified viral hepatitis C without hepatic coma
